summary: Candidate skill 'Maintain placeholder visibility to prevent space collapse' is a complementary implementation detail of space reservation for late-loading content. It describes the placeholder display mechanism that prevents reserved space from collapsing—a concern already addressed in the two peer candidates. The candidate should merge into the existing space reservation skills, which can be strengthened to explicitly include placeholder management as part of their workflow. The peer candidates are near-duplicates of each other and should also be consolidated.
